features.name: On air + public delivery URL
features.summary: On air is a real backend state (channels.on_air), separate from the encoder being up. Going on air is refused until the packaged output has valid content; stopping the channel takes it off air. A gated public URL /live/:id/master.m3u8|manifest.mpd returns the stream ONLY when on air with valid content (off air => 404, on air but broken => 503, else 302 to CloudFront in prod / origin locally). The On-air gate is honest: READY (blue) private, ON AIR (green) when truly serving valid content, FAILED (red) when published but broken.

test.how: Start a channel, confirm output previews as READY, click Go on air (disabled until output is valid), open the public HLS/DASH links in the banner; Take off air => links 404.

features.name: Live output trust (live-edge ingest + live-lock)
features.summary: HLS ingest starts at the live edge (-live_start_index -1) so the packaged output tracks the true source and restarts re-acquire live instead of replaying old content. The output player holds the live edge and self-heals after stalls (snaps back when it drifts >12s) so it stays honestly live; DVR only when the operator scrubs. KNOWN OPEN ITEM: the Wowza test source has irregular segment durations + non-monotonic audio DTS (Shaka logs overlapping-segment warnings) which can cause brief hiccups; needs a soak test to confirm content is consistently at the true live point.

test.how: Run a channel for 20+ min; compare the SOURCE pane (true source) to the OUTPUT pane; confirm OUTPUT stays at live edge and content matches within normal latency.

features.checks: encoder.log confirms live_start_index applied + real-time segment writes; player live-lock added. Content-age soak test still needed.
